---

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Positioning
FarmsKing is India's premier Smart Agriculture, Agronomy Intelligence, and Farm Digitization Platform developed and operated by **FARMSKING TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED**. Guided by the official motto "Farming Easy, Farming Smart", FarmsKing is dedicated to providing Indian farmers, gardeners, and agribusinesses with accessible, highly reliable digital technology.

Core Pillars of the Ecosystem:
- **Farms King**: Full-lifecycle farm and plot management, crop stage tracking, and weather advisories.
- **Garden King**: Urban gardening, terrace flora, kitchen gardening, and upcoming live plant delivery.
- **AI King**: Deep multimodal neural vision leaf disease pathology (<820ms response time).
- **Organic King**: 100% Genuine, verified organic inputs, microbial vermicompost, and zero fake products.
- **Account King**: Digital double-entry bahi-khata ledger tracking cultivation costs and mandi sales profit.

---

## 2. Institutional Standards & Farmer Trust Guarantees
- **ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management**: Every agronomic recommendation, disease treatment, and product seller on the platform undergoes strict quality control.
- **ISO 27001 Data Security**: Bank-grade encryption for all farmer data, land records, transaction histories, and partner KYC.
- **ICAR-Aligned Protocols**: All crop diagnostic and spray recommendations strictly adhere to Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) guidelines.
- **Zero Fake Products Guarantee**: Zero tolerance for counterfeit fertilizers or adulterated chemicals; all sellers are physically verified.
- **Strict Scope Boundaries**:
  - Zero sales of physical machinery or heavy hardware tools.
  - Zero equipment or tractor rental/leasing operations.
  - Zero farm machinery manufacturing.
  - Exclusively dedicated to digital agritech software, AI plant pathology, live APMC mandi data, certified organic inputs, and farm ledger management.

---

## 3. Comprehensive Master Feature & Capability Directory

### Feature 1: AI Crop Doctor & Leaf Pathology Engine
- **Web URLs**: https://farmsking.in/ai-doctor | https://farmsking.in/crop-disease-scanner
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - Model Architecture: Multimodal Convolutional Vision Transformer trained on 250,000+ verified leaf disease images across 50+ crop varieties.
  - Inference Latency: <820 milliseconds on edge cloud infrastructure.
  - Diagnostic Scope: Fungal leaf blights, powdery/downy mildews, rusts, bacterial cankers, viral mosaic patterns, and macro/micronutrient deficiencies (Nitrogen, Zinc, Iron, Magnesium).
  - Treatment Delivery: Dual-path treatment plan providing both ICAR-calibrated chemical sprays and 100% organic/biological remedies.

### Feature 2: APMC Mandi Intelligence & Wholesale Rates
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - Direct integration with agricultural marketing boards and APMC wholesale arrival networks.
  - Real-time updates on Min, Max, and Modal prices across 50+ crops (Wheat, Paddy, Mustard, Cotton, Potato, Maize, Sugarcane, Pulses, Vegetables).
  - Geo-proximity matching to locate the nearest mandi yards in Punjab (Khanna, Makhu, Goindwal Sahib, Jalandhar, Ludhiana, Bathinda) and national hubs.

### Feature 3: Precision Spray Dosage Calculator
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/dose
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - Input parameters: Crop variety, plot area (acres/hectares), sprayer tank capacity (16L backpack, 500L tractor trolley), and disease severity level.
  - Output: Exact chemical milliliters/grams, water dilution ratio, and safety pre-harvest intervals (PHI).

### Feature 4: Kisan Crop Intelligence & Agronomy Engine
- **Web URLs**: https://farmsking.in/crop-intelligence | https://farmsking.in/kisan-crop-intelligence-engine.html
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - Dynamic agronomic advice tailored to crop growth stages (Seedling, Vegetative, Tillering, Flowering, Grain Filling, Harvesting).
  - Hyper-local weather forecasting including rain probability, wind speed, relative humidity, and optimal spray time windows.

### Feature 5: Punjab Kheti Advisory
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/punjab-kheti-advisory.html
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - Regional focus on Punjab agricultural agro-climatic zones (Sub-mountain undulating zone, Undulating plain zone, Central plain zone, Western plain zone, Western zone).
  - Complete agronomic calendars for Basmati (1509, 1121, 1718), PR Paddy varieties, Wheat (HD-2967, HD-3086, PBW-824), and Sarson/Mustard.

### Feature 6: Reverse Sowing Engine & Yield Estimator
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/reverse-sowing-engine.html
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - Reverse calculation algorithm that takes target harvest window or peak market price timing and calculates the precise sowing/transplanting date.

### Feature 7: Certified Organic Agri Store
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/shop
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - 100% verified authentic bio-fertilizers, microbial vermicompost, cold-pressed neem extracts, and certified seeds.
  - Direct manufacturer and certified seller inventory dispatch with full batch traceability.

### Feature 8: Real-Time Order Tracking & Digital Tax Invoices
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/order-tracking
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - Real-time delivery integration, automated shipping status, and instant PDF download of GST tax invoices.

### Feature 9: Satellite Remote Sensing & Plot Telemetry
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/you (via Farmer Portal)
- **Technical Specifications**:
  - 6-Constellation satellite imagery ingestion (Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, ISRO Bhuvan).
  - Vegetation health index (NDVI), Normalized Difference Moisture Index (NDMI), and Enhanced Vegetation Index (EVI).

### Feature 10: Urban & Terrace Gardening (Garden King)
- **Web URL**: https://farmsking.in/topic/Gardening
- **Technical Specifications**:

## 4. Multi-Category Unified Identity (Single King ID & Mobile Number)
A user can access all three spaces on one mobile number:
- **Clients Portal**: Farmers, Gardeners, Customers, Supervisors
- **Partners Portal**: Sellers, Crop Doctors, Garden Advisors, Sales Managers, Traders
- **Staff Portal**: Admin, Super Admin, Managers, Operators, Trainers, Accountants
